title: Window seat rebuilt in a glass box window
summary: The seat in a glass box window stripped out and rebuilt: new timbers, insulation and a new level top.
intro: The old seat in this glass box window came out completely. Underneath I put in new timbers, packed the gaps with insulation, boarded over and fitted a new top, checked level along its length.
